title: Land Grants (Special Provisions) Act
long_title: AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR THE VESTING IN THE STATE, OF AGRICULTURAL OR ESTATE LAND WHICH IS VESTED IN THE LAND REFORM COMMISSION UNDER THE LAND REFORM LAW; TO ENABLE THE TRANSFER, FREE OF CHARGE, TO THE LANDLESS, OF THE LANDS SO VESTED IN THE STATE; AND TO PROVIDE FOR MATTERS CONNECTED THEREWITH OR INCIDENTAL THERETO.

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

omitted_provisions.reported_text: means the Land Reform Law, No. 1 of 1972, as amended by Law No. 39 of 1975

reported_node.text: means the Land Reform Law, No. 1 of 1972, as amended by Law No. 39 of 1975

omitted_provisions.reason: Section 20 of this edition defines seven terms. The Act is reported to define eight, the eighth being 'Land Reform Law'. That term is used unglossed in sections 2 (1), 2 (4) (b) and in three definitions in section 20, so a definition of it is expected.
omitted_provisions.source_note: Reported from the original 1979 Act text during review. Not present in the parsed consolidated page and not checked against a copy held in this corpus. Promote the node above into the body only once an edition carrying it has been read.

overrides_applied.note: No second edition was consulted. Every correction below is reasoned from the parsed page itself and is marked corrected_from_parsed_edition_only. A revised-edition copy of Cap. 287 would settle them and supply the Schedule.

quality_flags.detail: Section 3 requires the instrument of disposition to be 'substantially in the Form set out in the Schedule hereto'. The Schedule is not in the parsed page; the page's 'Schedules' hyperlink is a dead relative link to docs/statutes/cons_stat_up2_2006/common/HTML/LegislativeConsFiles/htm/1981Y11V287C.htm. Nothing in this corpus can reproduce the prescribed Form.

The two-column layout leaks marginal notes into the body. Confirmed at section 13 ('disposition.' inside the sentence) and at the section 3 note ('Act' prefixed). Both are corrected here with the printed wording kept in raw_text and heading_raw.

Five corrections rest on the parsed page alone: the section 3 and 13 marginal notes, the section 13 body, the section 20 capitalisation, and the retyping of the section 10 list. None has been checked against a second edition.

Two divergences from the Act as reported are recorded rather than applied: the missing section 20 definition (omitted_provisions) and the section 9 (4) enactment cited (alternate_edition_variants). Both need an edition this corpus holds before the body is changed.

alternate_edition_variants.assessment: A material difference, not a transcription slip: the consolidated edition cites a different enactment from the one reported for the 1979 Act as passed. If the Agrarian Services Act displaced the Agricultural Lands Law here, that substitution happened through some instrument, and this register currently records no amendment for this Act at all. The cross-references in the body follow the parsed edition.

A nomination made in pursuance of this subsection shall be deemed not to be a disposition within the meaning of section 5(1) (a).

body.heading: Conditions to which a transfer under section 3 is deemed to be subject, to run with the land.
body.raw_text: 11. The burden of any condition to which any transfer of State land under section 3 is deemed to be subject, shall run with the land and shall be binding upon the transferee and upon all persons claiming that land through, from, or under, such transferee.
body.text: The burden of any condition to which any transfer of State land under section 3 is deemed to be subject, shall run with the land and shall be binding upon the transferee and upon all persons claiming that land through, from, or under, such transferee.

body.heading: Disposition of land transferred under section 3 without the consent in writing, of the Land Commissioner void and inoperative.
body.raw_text: 12. Where any person to whom any State land is transferred under section 3 effects a disposition of that land without the prior consent in writing of the Land Commissioner given in accordance with the provisions of section 5 (1) (a) such disposition shall be void and inoperative for all purposes.

body.heading: Rectification of errors, &c., in instrument of disposition.
body.raw_text: 13. Where it appears to the Government Agent of the administrative district within which any State land transferred under disposition. section 3 is situated that any instrument of disposition effecting such transfer contains any clerical or other error or requires amendment in respect of the description of the land comprised therein or in respect of the inscription or recital of the name or designation of the transferee or of any other material fact, such error may be rectified or such amendment may be made by an endorsement on such instrument of disposition signed by such Government Agent and the transferee; and any endorsement so signed shall be sufficient for all purposes to rectify the error or to effect the amendment; and the instrument on which any such endorsement is made shall have effect as though it had been originally issued or executed as so rectified or amended.

body.heading: Alluvial and other accretions to any land transferred under section 3.
body.raw_text: 14. Any alluvial or other accretion to any State land transferred under section 3 shall, together with all rights appertaining or belonging to such accretion, be the property of the State and is hereby declared to be vested in the State.

body.raw_text: 15. body.heading: Provisions of this Act to prevail over any other law.
body.raw_text: 19. The provisions of this Act shall have effect notwithstanding anything contained in any other written law and accordingly, in the event of any conflict or any inconsistency between the provisions of this Act and such other written law, the provisions of this Act shall prevail.
